tagline.zh: 插件与开源依赖一键配置 · 本机插件可管理 · 修复下载全部失败
tagline.en: One-click plugins and dependencies · managed local plugins · downloads fixed

items.zh: 插件一键配置：精选卡片或粘贴 owner/repo 直接查最新 Release、挑 Windows x64 包、下载、SHA-256 校验、安全解压并安装；保留「下载页」手动路径
items.en: One-click plugin setup: use a curated card or paste owner/repo to look up the latest release, pick the Windows x64 asset, download, verify SHA-256 and unpack an install — with the download page kept as a manual path.

items.zh: 开源依赖一键配置：FFmpeg / rclone / whisper.cpp / MediaMTX 在应用内查 Release → 下载 → 校验 → 安全解压 → 定位 exe → 写入依赖目录，已就绪则直接复用
items.en: One-click dependency setup: FFmpeg / rclone / whisper.cpp / MediaMTX are looked up, downloaded, verified, safely unpacked, located and written into the dependency folder — anything already present is reused.

items.zh: 本机插件管理：卸载整目录移入 plugins\local-backups（不硬删，可放回）、用户级 ⇄ 全局级迁移、只登记不移动的接管管理、打开文件夹；OBS 运行中一律拒绝卸载
items.en: Local plugin management: uninstall moves the whole folder into plugins\local-backups (never a hard delete, restorable), migrate user-level ⇄ global-level, register without moving files, open the folder — and uninstalling is refused while OBS is running.

items.zh: 手机摄像头从「显示地址」变成「能用起来」：推流二维码、查询 MediaMTX API 检测手机是否已推流、只对 sidecar 里的 mediamtx.exe 一键放行防火墙
items.en: The phone camera moved from "showing an address" to actually working: a streaming QR code, stream detection through the MediaMTX API, and one-click firewall allowance for the sidecar mediamtx.exe only.

items.zh: MediaMTX WebRTC 视频监看与 OBS WHIP 推流地址：手机浏览器看到的是真实视频流而不是截图；不满足条件时回退到 1~5 FPS 截图监看
items.en: WebRTC monitoring through MediaMTX plus an OBS WHIP ingest address, so the phone browser sees a real video stream instead of screenshots — falling back to 1–5 FPS stills when the requirements aren't met.

items.zh: 字幕与归档：whisper 推荐模型固定 URL + 固定 SHA-256 + 200 MB 上限一键下载；「录制结束后自动归档」默认关闭；历史录像只做文件级索引
items.en: Captions and archiving: the recommended whisper model downloads from a pinned URL with a pinned SHA-256 and a 200 MB cap; auto-archive after recording is off by default; the recording index stays file-level only.

items.zh: 功能中心：新增「运行环境准备」卡，集中列出 FFmpeg / rclone / whisper / MediaMTX / 模型的状态与一键按钮；18 项能力标注实验性 / 规划中 / 本地；直播日历与观众看板改为落盘
items.en: Feature centre: a new runtime-preparation card lists FFmpeg / rclone / whisper / MediaMTX / model status with one-click buttons; 18 capabilities carry experimental / planned / local badges; the stream calendar and audience dashboard now persist locally.

items.zh: 修复插件与依赖下载全部失败：GitHub Release 资产 302 到 release-assets.githubusercontent.com 后被旧白名单拒绝；现放行新 CDN（并兼容旧重定向），失败原因写入 host / 状态码 / 体积日志
items.en: Fixed every plugin and dependency download failing: GitHub release assets now 302 to release-assets.githubusercontent.com, which the old allow-list rejected. The new CDN is allowed (with the old redirect kept for compatibility) and failures log host, status code and size.

tagline.zh: 状态可信度修复：停止录制后不再显示「录制中」
tagline.en: Trustworthy state: stopping a recording no longer leaves it showing as active

items.zh: 停止录制后电脑端不再一直显示「录制：进行中」：状态事件是权威来源，查询只补时长与字节数，冲突时 3 秒内以事件为准，另有每 3 秒一次的轻量对账
items.en: Stopping a recording no longer leaves the desktop showing it as active: state events are authoritative, queries only fill in duration and bytes, an event wins any conflict within three seconds, and a light reconciliation runs every three seconds.

items.zh: 手机端刷新 / 重连时先向 OBS 对一次输出状态；状态灯按真实状态区分「直播中」「录制中」「直播中 · 录制中」，只录制时不再显示「直播中」
items.en: The phone now reconciles output state with OBS on refresh or reconnect, and its status light distinguishes live / recording / live-and-recording — recording alone no longer shows "live".

items.zh: 批量状态查询协议修正：改用 obs-websocket 5.x 的 RequestBatch（op 8 / 9）与协议要求的数字执行方式，连接后的录制 / 推流 / 虚拟摄像头状态、静音与音量重新实时刷新
items.en: Fixed the batch state protocol: it now uses obs-websocket 5.x RequestBatch (op 8 / 9) with the numeric execution type the protocol expects, so record / stream / virtual-camera states plus mute and volume refresh live again after connecting.

items.zh: 为什么不用 Parallel：在 OBS 33.0.1 + obs-websocket 5.7.6 上实测 executionType=2 会把 results 错配到别的子请求，故默认串行执行
items.en: Why not Parallel: on OBS 33.0.1 with obs-websocket 5.7.6, executionType=2 mismatches results onto other sub-requests, so execution is serial by default.

items.zh: 其它：不在录制 / 推流时 RecordElapsed / StreamElapsed 固定返回 0；小窗「还可录约 X 分钟」改为整数显示，不再出现一长串小数
items.en: Also: RecordElapsed / StreamElapsed return 0 when nothing is running, and the mini window's "about X minutes left" rounds to an integer instead of printing a long fraction.

tagline.zh: 详情图标修复 · 手机改提词稿修复 · 赞助码
tagline.en: Icon fixes · phone-side teleprompter editing fixed · sponsorship codes

items.zh: 设置页右侧头部与功能中心模块卡改为正确的描边渲染，不再把圆 / 方框填成实心色块（语言与地区页不再只剩一个圆点）
items.en: Settings headers and feature-centre module cards now render outlined icons properly instead of filling circles and squares with solid colour — the Language & Region page is no longer a single dot.

items.zh: 图标语义重配：语言=地球、外观=调色板、后台=托盘、录制=摄像机、自动切换=双向箭头、热键=键盘、AI=芯片、数据=数据库、关于=信息圆（Tabler Icons，MIT）
items.en: Icons re-matched to meaning: globe for language, palette for appearance, tray for background, camera for recording, arrows for auto-switch, keyboard for hotkeys, chip for AI, database for data, info circle for about (Tabler Icons, MIT).

items.zh: 手机远程改提词稿失败修复：窗口操作与状态事件切回 UI Dispatcher，手机保存后电脑端提词器立即刷新，不再被路由吞成「操作失败」
items.en: Fixed phone-side teleprompter editing: window operations and state events moved back to the UI dispatcher, so a phone save refreshes the desktop teleprompter immediately instead of being swallowed as "operation failed".

items.zh: 窗口尚未打开时也先写入脚本文件，下次呼出即为新稿；旧稿自动备份最近 5 份
items.en: Even with the window closed the script file is written, so the next summon shows the new text — and the last five scripts are backed up.

items.zh: 新增支付宝 / 微信赞助码（只保留二维码本体、随包离线可扫），并在界面写明赞助不解锁任何功能、不改变任何权限
items.en: Added Alipay / WeChat sponsorship QR codes (QR only, bundled for offline scanning) with an explicit note that sponsoring unlocks no features and changes no permissions.

tagline.zh: 数据安全 · 无障碍 · Win7 旧协议兼容 · 回放缓存与简单开播
tagline.en: Data safety · accessibility · legacy Win7 protocol · replay buffer and simple stream start

items.zh: 数据安全（本版主线）：所有「写用户文件」的动作走同一条事务通道 —— 写前快照 + 原子替换 + 校验读回，中途失败自动回滚并保留唯一的恢复副本；路径护栏覆盖全部写 basic.ini 的入口（净化成单个目录名 + 二次断言落在 OBS 配置目录内，可信根改为登记制），机密存储读失败不再被当成「空存储」整份覆盖写回
items.en: Data safety is the headline: every write to user files goes through one transaction channel — snapshot, atomic replace and read-back verification, with automatic rollback that keeps the only recovery copy; path guardrails now cover every entry point that writes basic.ini (sanitised to a single directory name, asserted to stay inside the OBS config folder, with explicit trust-root registration), and a failed secret-store read is no longer treated as an empty store that gets written back over your keys.

items.zh: 无障碍适配：键盘焦点可见并可用空格 / 回车激活、Toast 走读屏实时区域播报、跟随 Windows 高对比主题与系统「文本大小」，危险确认框的默认按钮落在「取消」
items.en: Accessibility: visible keyboard focus with space / enter activation, toasts announced through screen-reader live regions, following the Windows high-contrast theme and system text size, and destructive confirmations defaulting to Cancel.

items.zh: 双构建 + Win7 旧协议兼容：主构建面向 Windows 10 / 11（.NET 10），兼容构建面向 Windows 7 SP1+（.NET 6），安装包 / 便携包 / 增量包两条线分别发布，按系统选一个即可；兼容构建支持旧协议 obs-websocket 4.x（默认端口 4444，鉴权算式 / 请求映射 / 事件映射逐条对照官方协议），数据目录独立为 %LocalAppData%\OBS_Helper_Win7，与主构建互不影响
items.en: Two builds and legacy Win7 protocol support: the main build targets Windows 10 / 11 (.NET 10) and the compatible build covers Windows 7 SP1+ (.NET 6), each with its own installer, portable and delta package — pick the one matching your system. The compatible build speaks legacy obs-websocket 4.x (default port 4444, with the v4 auth algorithm, request and event mappings checked against the official protocol) from its own data directory %LocalAppData%\OBS_Helper_Win7, so the two builds never clash.

items.zh: 回放缓存一键存片：托盘菜单与全局热键 Ctrl+Alt+V 保存「刚才那段」，未开缓存时按钮自动禁用，旧协议同样支持
items.en: One-click replay-buffer saving from the tray menu or the Ctrl+Alt+V hotkey; the button disables itself when the buffer is off, and the legacy protocol supports it too.

items.zh: 简单开播：按下之前先查「已经在播 / 没连上 OBS / 没填服务器 / 没填串流密钥」，并提示上行拥塞、已在下行丢帧与同时录制；开播后显示已播时长、按已发送字节实测的码率与丢帧率，且串流密钥不进本应用
items.en: Simple stream start checks "already live / OBS unreachable / no server / no stream key" before you press it and warns about uplink congestion, dropped frames and simultaneous recording; once live it shows elapsed time, bitrate measured from bytes sent and drop rate — and the stream key never enters the app.

items.zh: 录制档案 + 录制中打点：每次录制留档（时长 / 大小 / 丢帧 / 打点），热键 Ctrl+Alt+K 标记精彩瞬间，停止后可导出章节并批量无损转 MP4（不重编码）
items.en: Recording archive with in-recording markers: every recording is logged (duration, size, dropped frames, markers), Ctrl+Alt+K drops a highlight marker, and after stopping you can export chapters and batch-remux to MP4 losslessly.

items.zh: 配置回收站：OBS 配置的每次改写都在本地留一份副本，可一键放回原位，恢复绝不覆盖已有文件；被锁定（回滚未竟）的副本永远不会被自动清理
items.en: Config recycle bin: every rewrite of the OBS config keeps a local recovery copy that can be restored in one click, restoring never overwrites an existing file, and copies locked by an unfinished rollback are never auto-cleaned.

items.zh: 开播前体检 + 一键处方：黑屏体检、编码顾问、带宽计算、磁盘测速、节点探测一次跑完，按严重度给一句人话结论与建议档位；推流侧只给建议，绝不自动改
items.en: Pre-stream checkup with one-click prescription: black-screen, encoder, bandwidth, disk-speed and node probes in one pass, ranked by severity into a plain-language verdict and a suggested recording preset — streaming settings are advised, never changed automatically.

items.zh: 我的模板 + 我的知识库 + 搜索增强：把当前场景集合反向存成模板（顺序 / 来源 / 滤镜 / 分组都带上），知识库可自建条目与分类、与内置 212 条按 id 合并；搜索支持拼音首字母、同义词与字段加权排序
items.en: My templates + my knowledge base + better search: capture the current scene collection as a template (order, sources, filters and groups included) and write your own KB entries and categories, merged by id with the built-in 212; search gains pinyin initials, synonyms and weighted field ranking.

items.zh: 质量基线：单元测试 630 → 1209 项全部通过，无界面自检 26 项（主构建与 Win7 兼容构建各跑一次），增量更新改为对齐 GitHub 资产 SHA-256 摘要；发布物仍未做代码签名，Win7 上的 v4 握手未在真机与 OBS 27 上验证
items.en: Quality baseline: unit tests went from 630 to 1209, all passing, plus 26 headless self-check items run once per build, and incremental updates now verify against the GitHub asset SHA-256 digest. The artefacts still carry no code signature, and the v4 handshake has not been verified on a real Windows 7 machine with OBS 27.

tagline.zh: 更名「OBS帮助助手」· 图标统一 · 文档同步
tagline.en: Renamed to OBS帮助助手 · unified icon · docs aligned

items.zh: 「OBS 排障助手」正式更名为「OBS帮助助手」（英文侧仍为 OBS Helper）：窗口标题、托盘提示与通知、新手引导、诊断报告署名、安装向导的快捷方式 / 卸载项 / 完成页全部换名
items.en: Renamed from "OBS 排障助手" to "OBS帮助助手" (the English name stays OBS Helper): window title, tray tooltip and notifications, onboarding, diagnostic report byline and the installer's shortcuts / uninstall entry / finish page all follow.

items.zh: 改名时刻意不动的四样东西：AppId（Inno 靠它把新包认成「升级」而不是并存装两份）、OBS_Helper.exe（增量更新与用户已有快捷方式都指着它）、%LocalAppData%\OBS_Helper\（prefs.json / secrets.dat 在此）、Release 资产命名
items.en: Four things deliberately left untouched: AppId (so Inno reads the new package as an upgrade rather than a second install), OBS_Helper.exe (incremental updates and existing shortcuts point at it), %LocalAppData%\OBS_Helper\ (home of prefs.json / secrets.dat) and the release asset names.

items.zh: 安装目录默认值改为 {autopf}\OBS帮助助手，但 Inno 升级时沿用「上次安装目录」——2.9.5 及更早的用户升级后仍装在原目录，只有全新安装才用新目录名
items.en: The default install directory becomes {autopf}\OBS帮助助手, but Inno reuses the previous directory on upgrade — anyone on 2.9.5 or earlier stays where they were; only a fresh install gets the new folder name.

items.zh: 应用窗口 / 任务栏 / 托盘 / 安装包的图标与仓库封面统一为同一枚（深色圆角底 + 显示器 + 健康波形 + 录制指示点 + 体检对勾），并为 16 / 24 / 32 px 单独重绘，托盘与任务栏不再糊成一团
items.en: App, taskbar, tray and installer icons now match the repository artwork (dark rounded tile, monitor, health waveform, record dot and check badge), redrawn separately at 16 / 24 / 32 px so tray and taskbar stay sharp.

items.zh: 图标生成脚本 NOBS/scripts/gen_appicon.py 重写并入库（源 = 仓库图标），结果可复现
items.en: The icon generator (NOBS/scripts/gen_appicon.py) was rewritten and committed, driven by the repository artwork so the result is reproducible.

items.zh: 根 README / English README / NOBS README / 贡献指南 / 安全策略 / 行为准则 / 架构文档 / Issue 与 PR 模板全部对齐 2.9.6；品牌三图按新名重新渲染
items.en: Root README, English README, NOBS README, contribution guide, security policy, code of conduct, architecture doc and the issue / PR templates all aligned to 2.9.6; brand images re-rendered under the new name.

items.zh: 本版不新增功能 —— 这是一次「改名 + 换图标 + 对齐文档」的发布，升级路径、安装目录、数据目录与增量更新全都没动
items.en: No new features here — this is a rename, icon and documentation pass; the upgrade path, install directory, data directory and incremental updates are untouched.

tagline.zh: 私密反馈通道修正（GitHub 无私信）· 安全策略中英双语
tagline.en: Private reporting path fixed (GitHub has no DMs) · bilingual security policy

items.zh: 修掉一条走不通的反馈指引：GitHub 并没有面向任意用户的私信功能，原先写的「GitHub 私信维护者」已改为仓库 Security → Report a vulnerability（推荐）或邮件
items.en: Fixed an unreachable feedback path: GitHub has no direct-message feature for arbitrary users, so the old "DM the maintainer" route becomes the repository's Security → Report a vulnerability (preferred) or email.

items.zh: 应用内反馈卡补一行安全上报引导（中英双语），让用户在点「到 GitHub 提 Issue」之前就知道安全问题不该贴在公开 Issue 里
items.en: The in-app feedback card gained a short security-reporting note in both languages, so users learn before hitting "open a GitHub issue" that vulnerabilities don't belong in a public issue.

items.zh: SECURITY.md 改为中英两个完整版本（原来只有中文正文 + 英文摘要），写明支持范围、私密报告方式，以及报告应包含与不应包含的内容（流密钥 / 密码 / 未脱敏日志）
items.en: SECURITY.md becomes two full versions (previously Chinese text with an English summary), spelling out supported scope, private reporting routes, and what a report should and should not contain (stream keys, passwords, unsanitised logs).

items.zh: 语言口径写清楚：中文、英文、中英双语都行；CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md 与 CONTRIBUTING.md 同步为双语正式版，举报渠道由「私信」改为邮件
items.en: The language policy is now explicit — Chinese, English or both are all fine; CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and CONTRIBUTING.md are full bilingual versions, with reporting moved from DMs to email.

items.zh: 功能行为与 V2.9.4 完全相同，本版只改文档、引导与应用内的一处提示文案
items.en: Behaviour is identical to V2.9.4 — this release only touches documentation, onboarding and one in-app notice.

tagline.zh: 简单录像（一键配置 OBS 并开录）· 帮助与反馈页 · 626 项单测全通过
tagline.en: Simple recording (configure OBS and start in one go) · help & feedback page · 626 unit tests passing

items.zh: 首页新增「简单录像」卡：三档预设（快速录像 / 会议网课 / 游戏高码率）只回答「录什么」，输出模式、编码器族与码率一律不碰，需要时走「高级设置」跳录制环境部署卡
items.en: A new "Simple recording" card on the home page: three presets (quick, meeting / lecture, high-bitrate game) decide only what to record — output mode, encoder family and bitrate are left alone, with an "advanced settings" link to the recording-setup card.

items.zh: 预设只写「录像格式 / 录像质量 / 音频轨 / 分段」这几类可验证的键，帧率与分辨率复用 V2.9.3 的同一份目标，避免两条写入路径漂移
items.en: Presets only write verifiable keys (recording format / quality / audio track / segmentation) and reuse the same frame-rate and resolution targets as V2.9.3, so the two write paths cannot drift apart.

items.zh: OBS 没启动时可由本工具接手：先整备份 basic.ini → 弹出确认 → 拉起 obs64.exe → 每秒轮询等 obs-websocket 就绪（最长 75 秒）→ 自动开录
items.en: If OBS isn't running the tool takes over: back up basic.ini first, ask for confirmation, launch obs64.exe, poll until obs-websocket is ready (up to 75 seconds), then start recording on its own.

items.zh: 没连上但 OBS 进程在跑时不落地、不拉起，只给原因与出口；录制中 / 推流中直接阻断，不写任何配置（建计划与执行点各判一次）
items.en: If it can't connect but OBS is running, nothing is written and nothing is launched — you get the reason and a way forward. While recording or streaming it blocks outright and writes no config at all, checked both when planning and when executing.

items.zh: 录前只有一行结论：就绪，或阻断 + 原因 + 出口，并声明「本工具不会替你静默改配置或重启 OBS」；判定按硬门槛排序，不再把「直播中不能改输出参数」笼统归到「没连上」
items.en: One line before you record: ready, or blocked with a reason and an exit, plus an explicit "this tool won't silently change your config or restart OBS". The verdict follows hard gates, so "can't change output while streaming" no longer passes as "not connected".

items.zh: 录制中显示已录时长与剩余可录：时长优先取 OBS 自报的 outputTimecode（暂停不计入），剩余按空闲空间与预设码率估算
items.en: While recording you see elapsed and remaining time: elapsed prefers OBS's own outputTimecode (pauses excluded), while remaining is estimated from free space and the preset bitrate.

items.zh: 录完读回文件大小（正面回应「录完才发现是空文件」），可一键打开目录；本机有 ffmpeg 时可一键无损转封装为 MP4，没有时给出 OBS 自带「文件 → 重新封装录像」的路径
items.en: When recording stops the file size is read back (a direct answer to "the file turned out empty"), with one-click open-folder access, and a lossless remux to MP4 when ffmpeg is available locally — otherwise you're pointed at OBS's own File → Remux Recordings.

items.zh: 质量基线：单元测试 626 项全部通过（V2.9.1 时为 381 项）；Headless 自检 22 项 PASS（路由 18 项）；双目标构建 0 错误
items.en: Quality baseline: all 626 unit tests pass (381 back in V2.9.1), 22 headless self-check items PASS (18 of them routing), and both build targets compile with zero errors.

tagline.zh: 点击交互修复：动画不再抢占鼠标捕获
tagline.en: Click-interaction fix: the animation no longer steals mouse capture

items.zh: 彻底修复「页面很多地方点击不了」：点击动画 ClickAnim 不再抢占鼠标捕获，改在本轮输入处理完成之后再释放
items.en: Fixed the "lots of places on the page can't be clicked" problem: the ClickAnim animation no longer steals mouse capture, releasing it only after the current input round is handled.

items.zh: 修复「点击之后动画有延迟」：回弹动画不再写进延迟调度回调，按住期间也不会被悬停动画顶掉；动画时长收敛为按下 60ms / 回弹 140ms / 悬停 120ms
items.en: Fixed the delay after clicking: the release animation is no longer pushed into a deferred dispatcher callback and can't be overridden by hover while held; durations tightened to 60ms press / 140ms release / 120ms hover.

items.zh: 交互语义不变：按下缩小，松开 / 拖出元素 / 离开可视树复位；「按住卡片拖出后松开」仍然取消导航
items.en: Interaction semantics unchanged: shrink on press, reset on release / drag-out / leaving the visual tree, and dragging a card out while held still cancels navigation.

items.zh: 校验方式：真实鼠标点击套件 32/32（侧栏 10 项导航、首页卡片 16 次点击、10 个页面的 z 序探针），ClickAnim 行为单测 17/17（同一套用例在修复前实现上仅 9/17）
items.en: Verified with a real-mouse click suite at 32/32 (10 sidebar destinations, 16 home-page card clicks, z-order probes on 10 pages) and 17/17 ClickAnim behaviour unit tests — the same cases scored only 9/17 before the fix.

items.zh: v6.0.1 与 v6.0.0 的全部更新一并包含
items.en: Includes everything from v6.0.1 and v6.0.0.

tagline.zh: 修复全局按钮点击无响应
tagline.en: Fix: global button clicks stopped responding

items.zh: 修复全局按钮点击无响应：v5.9.1 引入的点击动画在预览抬起阶段提前释放鼠标捕获，导致 WPF ButtonBase 取消按压态、Click 事件不再触发；现改为在本轮输入处理完成后再释放捕获
items.en: Fixed unresponsive global button clicks: the click animation added in v5.9.1 released mouse capture during the preview-up phase, so WPF ButtonBase dropped its pressed state and never raised Click. Capture is now released after the current input round completes.

items.zh: v6.0.0 的全部更新一并包含
items.en: Includes everything from v6.0.0.

tagline.zh: 新增 WiFi 密码模块 · 模块精简
tagline.en: New WiFi-password module · modules trimmed

items.zh: 新增「WiFi 密码」模块：一键列出本机已保存的无线网，查看 / 复制明文密码（netsh 只读查询，不修改任何设置；显示前双重确认）
items.en: New "WiFi password" module: lists saved wireless networks and reveals or copies the plain-text password on one click — a read-only netsh query that changes nothing, with a double confirmation before revealing.

items.zh: 模块精简：移除「陪伴运行」小窗与「网站与官网」页（与 WIN 助手功能重复），聚焦新手修电脑核心场景
items.en: Modules trimmed: the "companion" mini window and the websites / official-site page were removed as duplicates of WIN Helper, keeping the focus on fixing a PC for beginners.

items.zh: 清理死代码（插件清单机制等），版本号进入 6.x
items.en: Dead code removed (plugin manifest machinery and friends); the version line moves into 6.x.

tagline.zh: 安全审查问题全部修复
tagline.en: All security-review findings fixed

items.zh: 修复安全审查报告中的全部问题：高危 H1–H3、中危 M1–M8、低危 L1–L17 逐条处理，版本升至 v2.1.0
items.en: Every finding in the security review was addressed — high H1–H3, medium M1–M8 and low L1–L17 — and the version moved to v2.1.0.

items.zh: README 重写并按实际实现校对：Avalonia 架构说明、功能总览、下载指引、项目结构与隐私承诺
items.en: README rewritten and fact-checked against the implementation: Avalonia architecture notes, feature overview, download guide, project layout and privacy commitments.

items.zh: 延续 v2.0.0 的 Avalonia 单进程原生架构，功能与 Windows 版继续对齐
items.en: Keeps the single-process native Avalonia architecture introduced in v2.0.0 and stays feature-aligned with the Windows build.

tagline.zh: Avalonia 单进程原生架构，与 Windows 版功能对齐
tagline.en: Single-process native Avalonia architecture, aligned with the Windows build

items.zh: 改用 Avalonia UI 单进程原生架构，替代早期的 Tauri + Web 方案：不再内嵌浏览器内核，启动更快、体积更小
items.en: Moved to a single-process native Avalonia UI architecture, replacing the earlier Tauri + Web approach: no embedded browser engine, faster launch and a smaller bundle.

items.zh: 功能与 Windows WPF 版完全对齐，并提供 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 两个 DMG，支持 macOS 12 及以上
items.en: Feature parity with the Windows WPF build, shipped as separate Apple Silicon and Intel DMGs for macOS 12 and later.

items.zh: 离线知识库 212+ 条分步排障方案、日志分析规则与场景模板全部内嵌，断网也能查
items.en: The offline knowledge base — 212+ step-by-step fixes, log-analysis rules and scene templates — is fully embedded and works without a network.

items.zh: 隐私优先：默认零网络请求；密码与 API Key 存入 macOS 系统钥匙串，绝不明文落盘
items.en: Privacy first: no network requests by default, and passwords / API keys live in the macOS keychain rather than on disk in plain text.

tagline.zh: 功能与 Windows 版对齐的 macOS 原生桌面应用
tagline.en: Native macOS app, feature-aligned with the Windows version

items.zh: 知识库完全离线：内置分类问题库与 Markdown 排障指引，断网也能用
items.en: Fully offline knowledge base: categorized Q&A and Markdown guides, usable without internet

items.zh: 本地智能诊断：读取系统信息、OBS 日志与配置，由本地规则引擎定位问题，零费用、纯离线
items.en: Local smart diagnosis: reads system info, OBS logs and config; on-device rule engine, free and fully offline

items.zh: 远程控制 OBS：切换场景、录制/推流/虚拟摄像头、音频管理、定时停止，支持菜单栏、全局热键、迷你小窗三种入口
items.en: Remote OBS control: scene switching, record/stream/virtual cam, audio, scheduled stop; via menu bar, global hotkeys or mini window

items.zh: 深度日志分析：离线解析 OBS 日志，脱敏 + 特征规则扫描，一键体检配置
items.en: Deep log analysis: offline OBS log parsing with sanitization and signature rules, one-click health check

items.zh: 场景模板一键落地：连上 OBS 一键生成场景与来源，或导出标准场景集合 JSON
items.en: One-click scene templates: generate scenes and sources on OBS, or export standard scene JSON

items.zh: 隐私优先：默认不发起任何网络请求，API Key 与 OBS 密码经系统钥匙串加密保存
items.en: Privacy first: no network requests by default; API keys and OBS passwords encrypted in the system keychain

tagline.zh: 适配 OBS Studio 33：新插件布局 + Qt 6.11.1
tagline.en: OBS Studio 33 support: new plugin layout plus Qt 6.11.1

items.zh: 跟随 OBS Studio 33 的插件布局：OBS 32 起改为「一插件一目录」的插件根，33 继续沿用，插件安装位置与枚举逻辑一并适配
items.en: Follows the OBS Studio 33 plugin layout: OBS 32 introduced one-folder-per-plugin roots and 33 keeps them, so installation paths and enumeration were adapted.

items.zh: 依赖的 Qt 运行时升级到 6.11.1 并随包分发，升级 OBS 之后不必再为「插件加载失败 / 面板消失」手动配库
items.en: The Qt runtime moved to 6.11.1 and ships with the plugin, so upgrading OBS no longer leaves you fixing "failed to load module" or a missing panel by hand.

items.zh: 七大专栏（体检 / 日志分析 / 设置体检 / 性能监控 / 插件管理 / 工具箱 / 系统信息）功能与 v2.8.0 一致，全程只读、零额外进程
items.en: The seven tabs — health check, log analysis, settings audit, performance monitor, plugin manager, toolbox and system info — are unchanged from v2.8.0, still read-only with zero extra processes.

tagline.zh: 录制健康体检 · 开播前一键自检
tagline.en: Recording health check-up · pre-flight self-check

items.zh: 新增录制路径预检：真实写入探测，专治 OBS 把无效路径误报成「磁盘空间不足」
items.en: New recording-path pre-check with a real write probe — aimed at the classic case where OBS blames "not enough disk space" for an invalid path.

items.zh: 损坏录制件扫描：找出 0KB 文件、异常小文件与「未收尾」的 MP4，并可批量转封装
items.en: Corrupt-recording scan: finds 0 KB files, suspiciously small files and MP4s that were never finalised, with batch remux.

items.zh: 回放缓存排障：定位「按了没反应」的头号成因 —— 已启用回放缓存却没绑定保存快捷键
items.en: Replay-buffer troubleshooting: identifies the number-one cause of "I pressed it and nothing happened" — replay buffer enabled with no save hotkey bound.

items.zh: 音频深度体检：逐项排查 Windows 麦克风隐私许可被拒等常见成因
items.en: Deep audio check-up: works through common causes such as a denied Windows microphone privacy permission.

items.zh: 开播前一键自检：把以上各项与 Game DVR、NVENC 驱动下限聚合为一次流程，开播前跑一遍即可
items.en: One-click pre-flight self-check: bundles all of the above with Game DVR and NVENC driver-version floors into a single pass you run before going live.

tagline.zh: 缺陷修复与工程质量（A / B 清单全部条目）
tagline.en: Defect fixes and engineering quality (full A / B checklists)

items.zh: 插件恢复不再静默删除同名 DLL：改为时间戳 .bak 备份 + 失败回滚
items.en: Plugin restore no longer silently deletes a same-named DLL: it keeps a timestamped .bak and rolls back on failure.

items.zh: 「一键改 MKV」改为零破坏性逐行替换 basic.ini，保留原文件的注释与换行风格
items.en: "One-click switch to MKV" now rewrites basic.ini line by line, preserving comments and line-ending style.

items.zh: 新增 TaskRunner 线程池：磁盘测速 / 录制体检 / 日志分析移出 UI 线程，移除 processEvents 反模式
items.en: New TaskRunner thread pool moves disk benchmarking, recording checks and log analysis off the UI thread, retiring the processEvents anti-pattern.

items.zh: 日志分析合并为单遍扫描；detach 线程统一托管回收；删除 managed/ 孤儿工程；RuleMatcher 预编译 pattern 并支持 20 万行扫描窗口
items.en: Log analysis folded into a single pass; detached threads centrally managed; the orphaned managed/ project removed; RuleMatcher precompiles patterns and handles 200k-line windows.

items.zh: 版本号单点维护（CMakeLists 为唯一来源，打包时自动解析）；GitHub API 调用补规范 User-Agent 与可选 token，并对限流给出友好提示
items.en: Version number now has a single source of truth (CMakeLists, parsed at packaging time); GitHub API calls send a proper User-Agent and an optional token, with a friendly rate-limit notice.

items.zh: TR 宏查表化：社区可通过 locales ini 增补语言而无须发版（附模板提取脚本）；tools_tab.cpp 按功能拆为 6 个编译单元，加入 .clang-format / .gersemirc
items.en: TR macros became table-driven so the community can add languages via locales ini without a release (a template extractor is included); tools_tab.cpp split into 6 translation units, with .clang-format / .gersemirc added.

tagline.zh: 录制体检 · 急救 + 开播前一键自检
tagline.en: Recording check-up & rescue, plus a pre-flight self-check

items.zh: 新增「录制体检 · 急救」：把录制路径、录制件与回放缓存等「录不上 / 录坏了」的常见成因做成一站式排查（R1 清单全部 7 项）
items.en: New recording check-up and rescue: a one-stop pass over the usual reasons recording fails or comes out broken — paths, recording files and the replay buffer (all 7 items of the R1 checklist).

items.zh: 新增开播前一键自检，与体检项共用同一套规则，避免两处结论不一致
items.en: New one-click pre-flight self-check that shares the same rule set as the check-up, so the two can't disagree.

tagline.zh: 资源增至 181 个 · 教程 100% 覆盖 · 许可证切换为 MIT
tagline.en: Library grows to 181 · 100% tutorial coverage · licence switched to MIT

items.zh: 新增 27 个 AI 制作资源，资源总数 154 → 181（视频 +4、网页 +6、图像 +5、音乐音频 +5、文本大模型 +7）
items.en: 27 new AI production resources take the library from 154 to 181 (video +4, web +6, image +5, music & audio +5, LLM +7).

items.zh: 每个新资源都配齐一句话简介、详细介绍与中文教程（核心步骤 + 可直接复制的提示词模板），教程共 181 篇、100% 覆盖
items.en: Every new resource ships with a one-line summary, a full write-up and a Chinese tutorial (core steps plus copy-paste prompt templates) — 181 tutorials, 100% coverage.

items.zh: 新增资源官方图标 25 枚（共 176 枚），未收录图标继续回退品牌色首字块
items.en: 25 new official icons (176 in total); resources without a usable icon still fall back to a brand-colour initial block.

items.zh: 许可证切换：GPL-2.0 → MIT，LICENSE、源码 SPDX 头、README 与关于页一并同步
items.en: Licence switched from GPL-2.0 to MIT, with LICENSE, source SPDX headers, README and the About page updated together.

tagline.zh: AI 工具官方图标 · 性能与健壮性
tagline.en: Official tool icons · performance and robustness

items.zh: 列表卡片与详情页头部不再只是「色块 + 首字」，直接展示各 AI 工具的官网官方图标（共 151 个）
items.en: Cards and detail headers no longer show just a colour block with an initial — they display each tool's official icon (151 in total).

items.zh: 图标来源为官网 favicon / apple-touch-icon 与 GitHub 组织头像，favicon.im 兜底；统一转为 ≤256px 透明 PNG 随应用内置，完全离线可用
items.en: Icons come from official sites' favicon / apple-touch-icon, GitHub org avatars, with favicon.im as a fallback; all normalised to ≤256px transparent PNGs bundled with the app, fully offline.

items.zh: 3 个只提供 SVG 占位图的工具（dora / haiper / haiyi）继续使用品牌色首字块回退，不影响体验
items.en: Three tools that only serve SVG placeholders (dora / haiper / haiyi) keep the brand-colour initial fallback without hurting the experience.

items.zh: 新增可复用下载脚本 tools/DownloadLogos.py，后续新增资源可一键批量补图（缺失清单见 tools/_missing_logos.json）
items.en: New reusable downloader tools/DownloadLogos.py so future resources can be batched with one command (missing entries tracked in tools/_missing_logos.json).

items.zh: Logo 路径改为惰性缓存：搜索 / 筛选刷新时不再对每张卡片重复访问磁盘
items.en: Logo paths are now lazily cached, so refreshing search or filters no longer hits the disk once per card.

items.zh: 资源 Id 增加路径安全校验，避免非法 Id 逃逸出图标目录
items.en: Resource IDs gained path-safety validation so a malformed ID can't escape the icon directory.

tagline.zh: 改为应用内下载 · 资源增至 154
tagline.en: In-app downloads · library grows to 154

items.zh: GitHub 渠道不再跳浏览器，改为应用内下载安装包：实时显示进度 / 速度 / 百分比，完成可一键「运行安装程序」或「打开所在文件夹」，支持取消与失败重试
items.en: The GitHub channel downloads in-app instead of opening a browser: live progress, speed and percentage, then one click to run the installer or open its folder, with cancel and retry.

items.zh: 蓝奏云渠道改为直接跳转浏览器（提取码在渠道对话框内展示），去掉原先的拦截式弹窗
items.en: The Lanzou channel now opens the browser directly (the access code is shown in the channel dialog), dropping the old interrupting popup.

items.zh: 修复「检查更新」后点击 GitHub / 蓝奏云均无法跳转的问题；设置页与启动自动检查共用同一流程
items.en: Fixed the case where clicking GitHub / Lanzou after "check for updates" did nothing; the settings page and the startup check now share one flow.

items.zh: 下载安全：仅允许本仓库 GitHub Release 直链、PE 文件校验、临时文件 .part + 原子替换（中断不会破坏旧安装包）
items.en: Download safety: only direct GitHub Release links from this repository, PE file validation, and .part temporary files with atomic replacement so an interrupted download can't corrupt the old installer.

items.zh: 新增 9 个优质 AI 工具（资源 145 → 154，教程 154/154 全覆盖）：Manus、Devin、Zed、DeepWiki、browser-use、Open Interpreter、Langflow、Napkin AI、D-ID
items.en: Nine more quality AI tools (library 145 → 154, tutorials 154/154): Manus, Devin, Zed, DeepWiki, browser-use, Open Interpreter, Langflow, Napkin AI and D-ID.

tagline.zh: 一个关于爱的 2.5D 叙事游戏
tagline.en: A 2.5D narrative game about love

items.zh: 9 段爱情故事改编剧情，AI 生成立绘，部分场景 CSS 3D 半立体呈现
items.en: 9 adapted love stories with AI-generated art and CSS 3D semi-stereoscopic scenes

items.zh: 点击推进剧情 + 双选项互动，进度自动保存，完全离线可玩
items.en: Tap to advance, two-choice interactions, auto-saved progress, fully offline

items.zh: 支持安卓 / Windows / 浏览器三端运行
items.en: Playable on Android / Windows / browser

tagline.zh: 省电渲染 · 陪伴统计落盘 · 提醒通道修复
tagline.en: Battery-friendly rendering · companionship stats persisted · reminder channel fixed

items.zh: 动画出帧上限 60fps：90 / 120Hz 高刷屏不再按屏幕刷新率全速重绘，超过 14ms 的重复帧直接跳过，只重新排帧
items.en: The animation frame rate is capped at 60 fps: 90 / 120 Hz screens stop redrawing at the panel's refresh rate, skipping repeated frames longer than 14 ms and only rescheduling.

items.zh: 熄屏 / 不可见暂停：窗口不可见（熄屏、被遮挡）时停止自刷新，恢复可见时立即重新拉起，避免后台空转
items.en: Refresh pauses when the screen is off or the window is hidden and resumes immediately on becoming visible, so nothing spins in the background.

items.zh: 修复今日陪伴时长恒为 0（严重）：统计入口此前没有调用方，现由前台服务按分钟批量累加，服务销毁时补末尾零头
items.en: Fixed today's companionship time always reading zero (a serious bug): the counter had no caller, and the foreground service now accumulates it per minute, adding the remainder when the service is destroyed.

items.zh: 久坐 / 喝水提醒静默修复：改走独立的高优先级通知渠道（IMPORTANCE_HIGH + 震动 + 角标），此前复用常驻通知的低优先级渠道
items.en: Fixed silent sit / water reminders: they now use their own high-importance channel (IMPORTANCE_HIGH with vibration and a badge) instead of reusing the low-importance persistent one.

items.zh: 通知点击无响应修复：常驻通知与提醒通知补上 contentIntent，点击直达主界面
items.en: Fixed unresponsive notification taps: both the persistent and reminder notifications now carry a contentIntent that opens the main screen.

items.zh: 陪伴小窗低写盘：每秒刷新的小窗改用只读内存态的取数方式，衰减结果改由低频路径合并落盘
items.en: Lower disk churn for the mini window: it now reads in-memory state instead of writing SharedPreferences every second, with decay results persisted by a lower-frequency path.

items.zh: 构建：versionCode 4 → 5，versionName 1.3.0 → 1.4.0；release 继续启用 R8 与正式签名
items.en: Build: versionCode 4 → 5 and versionName 1.3.0 → 1.4.0, with R8 and the real signing key kept for release builds.

tagline.zh: 新增网速检测与软件卸载 · 补齐提权与插件分发链路
tagline.en: Speed test and app uninstaller · elevation and plugin distribution completed

items.zh: 新增「网速检测」插件：下行 / 上行 / 延迟 / 抖动，多节点自动选优
items.en: New network speed test plugin: download / upload, latency and jitter, with automatic best-node selection.

items.zh: 新增「软件卸载」插件：按注册表登记的官方卸载程序卸载，卸载后按注册表记录的安装目录清理残留
items.en: New app uninstaller plugin: runs the official uninstaller registered for the app, then cleans leftovers from the install directory recorded in the registry.

items.zh: 补齐提权路径：需要管理员权限的操作会明确申请，不再静默失败
items.en: Completed the elevation path: operations that need administrator rights now request them explicitly instead of failing silently.

items.zh: 插件分发链路：下载按提交号取内容，彻底消除 CDN 缓存导致的「索引新、文件旧」
items.en: Plugin distribution now fetches content by commit hash, eliminating the stale-CDN "new index, old file" problem.

items.zh: 校验失败不再被重试期间的网络抖动掩盖：失败原因如实上报
items.en: Verification failures are no longer masked by network jitter during retries — the real reason is reported.

tagline.zh: 首次发布：插件式外壳 + 四个内置插件
tagline.en: First release: a plugin host with four built-in plugins

items.zh: 插件式外壳 + 插件市场：主程序只保留最必要的一套界面，功能以独立程序集按需下载加载
items.en: A plugin host plus a plugin market: the app keeps only the essential UI while features ship as standalone assemblies loaded on demand.

items.zh: 系统诊断：CPU / 内存 / 磁盘监控与健康评分
items.en: System diagnostics: CPU / memory / disk monitoring with a health score.

items.zh: 网络工具：网络适配器信息、DNS 解析与 Ping 测试
items.en: Network toolkit: adapter details, DNS resolution and ping tests.

items.zh: 故障排除指南：15 类常见电脑问题的修复步骤
items.en: Troubleshooting guide: fix paths for 15 common PC problems.

items.zh: 系统清理：当前账户临时文件扫描与清理
items.en: Cleanup: scans and clears temp files for the current account.

tagline.zh: 首次发布：Cookie 加密保存在本机，一键注入浏览器
tagline.en: First release: cookies encrypted on your machine, injected on demand

items.zh: 多网站 Cookie 加密写进单个 cookies.enc，明文永不落盘，密码错误无法解密
items.en: Per-site cookies are encrypted into a single cookies.enc — plaintext never touches disk and a wrong password can't decrypt it.

items.zh: 一键启动浏览器：临时用户目录注入 Cookie 后拉起浏览器，关闭窗口自动删除临时数据
items.en: One-click launch: a temporary profile receives the cookies, the browser starts, and the temp data is deleted once the window closes.

items.zh: 手动登录采集：打开可见浏览器登录账号 / 过验证码，回车后采集全部有效 Cookie；空结果拒绝保存
items.en: Manual capture: log in and pass any captcha in a visible browser, press Enter and every valid cookie is collected; empty results are refused.

items.zh: Cookie 管理：分号 / JSON / Cookie-Editor 三种格式粘贴导入，查看、删除需二次确认，改密码用新密钥整体重新加密
items.en: Cookie management: paste-import in semicolon, JSON or Cookie-Editor format, view, delete with confirmation, and change the password by re-encrypting everything.

items.zh: 导出 GitHub Action 保活配置：只含密文的 action_config_output.json + Fernet 密钥；主菜单导出另设二重密码
items.en: Export a GitHub Action keep-alive config: a ciphertext-only action_config_output.json plus the Fernet key, with a second export password from the menu.

items.zh: 双浏览器后端：内置 Thorium（离线自包含，自带 H.264 / AAC）或本机 Edge / Chrome（DRM 会员视频）
items.en: Two browser backends: bundled Thorium (offline, with H.264 / AAC) or local Edge / Chrome for DRM member content.
